campaign.title: Protocol 8:15 · 2. Why Did Ms Diop Lie?
campaign.finale: 8:28. A message from Karina: “I’m safe. Someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet.”

roles.name: Message checker
roles.card: You check messages. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it says.
roles.clue: Your picture: two school messages at 8:15. One says “Stay in classrooms.” One says “Go to the sports hall.”

card.ca: Comproves missatges. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què diu.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: dos missatges de l’institut a les 8:15. Un diu «Quedeu-vos a les aules». L’altre diu «Aneu al pavelló».

roles.name: People checker
roles.card: You listen to people. Look at your picture. Tell your team who said what.
roles.clue: Your picture: Youssef says, “Karina went to take a photo of the broken roof.”

card.ca: Escoltes la gent. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip qui va dir què.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: en Youssef diu: «La Karina va anar a fer una foto del sostre trencat».

roles.name: Document checker
roles.card: You read papers. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it says.
roles.clue: Your picture: the school storm plan. In a storm: stay in your classroom.

card.ca: Llegeixes documents. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què diu.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: el pla de tempesta de l’institut. Si hi ha tempesta: queda’t a l’aula.

roles.name: Place checker
roles.card: You look at places. Look at your picture. Tell your team what you see.
roles.clue: Your picture: a photo of the broken roof. It is over the covered passage, next to the sports hall.

card.ca: Mires llocs. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què hi veus.

clue.ca: La teva imatge: una foto del sostre trencat. És sobre el passadís cobert, al costat del pavelló.

chapters.title: 2. Why Did Ms Diop Lie?
chapters.intro: The camera saw Ms Diop with Karina. But Ms Diop says, “I did not see her.” You have a new picture. Look at your picture. Tell your team what it shows. Answer together.
chapters.recap: A camera saw Ms Diop with Karina. Ms Diop said she did not see her.
chapters.ending: 8:28. A message from Karina: “I’m safe. Someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet.”

objectives.text: Who warned the school about the roof first? Ask the Document checker and the Message checker.

help.ca: Qui va avisar primer l’institut del sostre? Pregunta al Document checker i al Message checker.

objectives.text: Where did Ms Diop take Karina? Ask the People checker and the Place checker.

help.ca: On va portar la senyora Diop la Karina? Pregunta al People checker i al Place checker.

objectives.text: Write together: “Ms Diop lied, but she… She took Karina to…”

help.ca: Escriviu junts: «La senyora Diop va mentir, però… Va portar la Karina a…»

objectives.successCriteria: Says that Ms Diop lied but helped: she warned the school about the roof on Friday, and/or she took Karina to the first-aid room by the safe path. Simple A2 sentences are fine.

discoveries.text: Security video, 8:07: Ms Diop and Karina go into the sports hall.

help.ca: Vídeo de seguretat, 8:07: la senyora Diop i la Karina entren al pavelló.

discoveries.text: Ms Sokolova: “I kept a copy of Ms Diop’s warning.”

help.ca: La senyora Sokolova: «Vaig guardar una còpia de l’avís de la senyora Diop».

reveals.text: Tip: Document checker and Message checker, compare your pictures. Who wrote the warning?

help.ca: Pista: Document checker i Message checker, compareu les vostres imatges. Qui va escriure l’avís?

reveals.text: Tip: People checker and Place checker, compare your pictures. Where does the safe path go?

help.ca: Pista: People checker i Place checker, compareu les vostres imatges. On va el camí segur?

roleClues.records-researcher: Your picture: Ms Diop’s warning. Friday, 9:20: “The passage roof is dangerous.”
roleClues.media-analyst: Your picture: the office receipt. The office got a warning on Friday at 9:45. A note says “Repair delayed.”
roleClues.witness-interviewer: Your picture: Ms Ionescu says, “Ms Diop took Karina out by the back door at 8:12.”
roleClues.site-observer: Your picture: a map. From the back door of the sports hall, the safe path goes to the first-aid room.

introImage.alt: Security camera at 8:07: a teacher and a student go into the sports hall.

endingImage.alt: A message from Karina’s account at 8:28: “I’m safe. Someone told Ms Diop to keep quiet.”

intro.ca: La càmera va veure la senyora Diop amb la Karina. Però ella diu: «No l’he vista». Tens una imatge nova. Mira la teva imatge. Explica al teu equip què mostra. Responeu junts.

recap.ca: Una càmera va veure la senyora Diop amb la Karina. Ella va dir que no l’havia vista.

ending.ca: 8:28. Un missatge de la Karina: «Estic bé. Algú va dir a la senyora Diop que callés».

records-researcher.ca: La teva imatge: l’avís de la senyora Diop. Divendres, 9:20: «El sostre del passadís és perillós».

media-analyst.ca: La teva imatge: el rebut de secretaria. Secretaria va rebre un avís divendres a les 9:45. Una nota diu «Reparació ajornada».

witness-interviewer.ca: La teva imatge: la senyora Ionescu diu: «La senyora Diop va treure la Karina per la porta del darrere a les 8:12».

site-observer.ca: La teva imatge: un mapa. Des de la porta del darrere del pavelló, el camí segur va a la infermeria.

records-researcher.alt: A safety warning from Friday 9:20: “The passage roof is dangerous. Close the passage. Repair the roof.” Reported by Awa Diop.

media-analyst.alt: The office receipt: warning received Friday 9:45. A later note says: Repair delayed.

witness-interviewer.alt: Ms Ionescu, a teacher, says: “Ms Diop took Karina out by the back door at 8:12.”

site-observer.alt: A map: the covered passage is closed. A safe path goes from the back door of the sports hall to the first-aid room.

finale.ca: 8:28. Un missatge de la Karina: «Estic bé. Algú va dir a la senyora Diop que callés».
